id: title:andrewm4894:claim slack relay before posting so retries never repost

review.reason: The change removes a workflow-level retry policy and replaces it with database-level idempotency and a rolling-window retention guard. P1.F1.H1 removes the retry configuration, while P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 establish and remove the database state tracking for relay IDs.
